checkpoints.question: Can targets and allowed information be identified?
observations: Six primary PDFs acquired and pinned.
Seven existing action labels match the primary voting records.
Two UK speeches announce draft support; show these separately.
Archived PDF publication timing remains unresolved.
Per-column extraction prevents adjacent-speaker contamination.
checkpoints.decision: Admit retrospective reconstruction tasks; do not claim clean prospective forecasting.

checkpoints.question: Can we score substantive policy behavior beyond votes?
observations: Eight authored questions cover position, qualification, attribution and bounded uncertainty.
Every positive content criterion has an exact source span.
Brazil climate supports policy evaluation without an invented vote.
checkpoints.decision: Use a separate policy checklist alongside the action scorer; test the criteria with reviewers.

checkpoints.question: Does rating arithmetic reject known bad treatment and missing reviews?
observations: 43 targeted tests pass.
Nineteen authored expectation fixtures receive the intended scoring treatment.
Fresh rebuilds match eight package files and six calibration files byte-for-byte.
Cached recollection preserves the acquisition receipt.
checkpoints.decision: Scoring plumbing is checked; semantic calibration and two independent reviewers remain pending.

checkpoints.question: Can the first probe preserve full inputs within the proposed budget?
observations: Thirty full A/B prompts: 44,384 input tokens; maximum 5,033.
Selected eight-output diagnostic: 17,124 input tokens, no truncation.
Y/N/A are single tokens with the locked tokenizer.
Trillium rejected SSH authentication; no job submitted.
checkpoints.decision: Finish instrumented decoding/probability tracing and run the bounded probe when compute authentication is restored; no training yet.

checkpoints.question: Will actual inference retain the information needed to diagnose errors and score confidence?
observations: A generation/direct-forward comparison checks first-token probability extraction.
A controlled Qwen3 test separates the model EOS list from the legacy single EOS without changing input tokens.
All eight complete prompts ran through tiny random Qwen3 on CPU; 17,124 input tokens and 32 infrastructure-only output tokens.
The isolated 16-file payload reproduces the same preflight.
55 combined targeted tests pass.
Trillium SSH authentication failed again; no job was submitted.
checkpoints.decision: Run the eight-output pinned-model GPU probe after authentication/scheduler validation, then inspect before expansion. Arrange two independent rubric ratings.
limitations: CPU random weights do not establish real model behavior or GPU throughput.
EOS handling can cause a mechanical difference but is not yet shown to explain prior repetition.

checkpoints.question: Can we run and inspect multiple experiments without reallocating?
observations: Authenticated multiplex connection restored.
def-zhijing association confirmed; no prior allocation to reuse.
All 17 staged files pass remote hashes; full tokenizer preflight matches.
Slurm job 996664 accepted and running on trig0042 with one H100.
Direct node SSH and live sleep infinity process verified.
srun is prohibited by the login-host wrapper; use node SSH first, then an allocation-bound step.
Probe is running as step 996664.0; its completion will retain the allocation.
checkpoints.decision: Inspect eight actual outputs before expanding. Retain allocation per user instruction.

checkpoints.question: Do actual generation settings and stopping match the recorded experiment?
observations: First GPU attempt failed the raw-logits/greedy guard because checkpoint sampling defaults overrode explicit GenerationConfig defaults.
A controlled regression test failed before the fix; 56 targeted tests pass after use_model_defaults=False.
Corrected eight-output probe completed with full prompts and 486 generated tokens.
Default versus legacy EOS changes only eos_token_id; all eight outputs/probabilities are identical.
Allocation survived both failure and successful experiment completion.
checkpoints.decision: Inference plumbing is validated for this base-model pack. Older trained-adapter repetition remains a separate replay before new adapter interpretation.

checkpoints.question: What does supplying the dated country speech add?
observations: 30 outputs: seven action pairs and eight policy pairs across two exposed historical events.
Action accuracy A 4/7, B 5/7; the extra correct prediction has an exact Y/N logit tie.
Both recorded abstentions are wrong in both arms; evidence lowers the probability of the correct abstention for India and Brazil.
B reduces action NLL from 2.467 to 2.069, while a country training prior reaches 1.707.
Assistant source checks identify corrected policy reversals and retained qualifications, but also unsupported assistance types in the France evidence answer.
All 30 outputs stop at EOS; no input truncation or output caps.
Sixteen real policy outputs now have a packet with arm/model labels hidden and blank independent-review templates.
checkpoints.decision: Keep B as the same-evidence baseline. Calibrate and obtain independent policy ratings, broaden reviewed event coverage, then select one bounded SFT comparison.

checkpoints.question: Which errors come from insufficient decision evidence, prompt sensitivity, unsupported elaboration or infrastructure?
observations: 34 diagnostic outputs completed; four exact baseline replays match.
Full country names flip three of four letter-label action outputs.
Natural word labels produce No for all four cases, including the France Yes control.
Neither removing the abstention warning nor clarifying the vote target fixes either missed abstention.
Two deliberately outcome-containing extraction controls correctly output A.
The post-vote record adds Brazil draft/process objections absent from the earlier supplied speech; it is analysis-only except in those oracle controls.
Claim-to-quotation instructions fix the selected France unsupported assistance types and recover duration; failures of coverage persist elsewhere.
Under-load GPU samples: 58–59% utilization, 18,379 MiB, 46–47 C, zero reported uncorrected ECC errors.
checkpoints.decision: Put source-sufficiency and prompt-invariance calibration before new SFT; compare to stronger source-grounded prompting, preserving original results.
limitations: Adaptive, selected-case diagnosis; no new unbiased benchmark score.
Observed prompt effects do not identify internal values or private diplomatic motives.

checkpoints.question: Can a complete, counterbalanced interface stabilize measurement without disguising wrong decisions?
measured_findings: All 14 original action prompts replay exactly.
The six-permutation mixture predicts Abstain for every historical decision in all four arm/name strata; accuracy 2/7.
Mixture agreement across names conceals wrong decisions; individual permutations still change some outputs.
All outputs parse and stop correctly; raw legal digit mass exceeds 0.9996.
checkpoints.decision: Preserve interface sensitivity as a reported failure. Complete independent semantic review and expand independent event families before training.
limitations: Exposed development events; no independent generalization claim.
Averaging is an ensemble estimator, not proof of calibration or model invariance.
Policy/source labels remain assistant-proposed until independent review.
Two exposed historical events; no independent family-level effect estimate.
Formal policy ratings and human agreement remain pending.
No new training, deliberation or final-test result.
